headings.text: How would you like to start?

textBlocks: Choose how you'd like to engage with our hiring partners.
Already have an account? Sign in
Pick a starting point — you can change it later.
Send your profile to a specific open role.
Stay visible to future roles that match your profile.
Apply now and stay in the network for future roles.
By continuing you agree to our privacy notice.
A global hiring system for teams that need consistent recruiting.
Weekly insights into talent acquisition. No spam.
No recruitment agency fees. No placement charges. Subscription-based hiring system.

h1: Join TaaSFlow in a few minutes.

headings.text: Join TaaSFlow in a few minutes.
Your first application is your join.

sections: Join TaaSFlow in a few minutes.
Your first application is your join.
textBlocks: Applying to any open brief creates your candidate account. No separate signup form — your first application is your join.
Up-to-date CV or resume as a PDF or DOCX (under 10 MB).
Your working preference: remote, hybrid or on-site — and eligible regions.
Compensation range and notice period, so we only match viable briefs.
Optional: LinkedIn URL, portfolio or references you'd like on file.
You get an application confirmation with a reference ID.
Structured status updates appear in your dashboard as the review progresses.
For briefs you rank on, we ask consent before sending your details to the client.
You can pause, edit or delete your profile at any time.
Every brief lists the requirements, working model and any relocation scope up front.
Upload your CV and answer the brief's screening questions. This creates your candidate account.
We parse your CV into a structured profile you can edit at any time from your dashboard.
Sign in to see application status, receive matches for future briefs, and message the team.
Yes. TaaSFlow is free for professionals. Employers subscribe to the service.
No. Many members stay privately discoverable and are only contacted for briefs that fit.
Never. Your profile is not indexed publicly and is not shown to any client without your explicit consent for that specific brief.
Use candidate sign in below to reach your dashboard, applications and messages.
Pick a brief that fits and apply — your candidate account is created in the same step.
A live recruiting workspace with ranked, evidence-backed candidate delivery.
